title: Lab - Advanced permissions
description: Grant access beyond owner/group/other and lock a file down.
scenario: Grant access beyond owner/group/other and lock a file down. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - ACL
tasks.instructions: Give user bob read access to /opt/lab/etc/app.conf without changing its group.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Default ACL
tasks.instructions: Make every new file in /opt/lab/logs readable by group devops.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Immutable
tasks.instructions: Make /opt/lab/etc/app.conf immutable and try to delete it as root.
tasks.verification: Operation not permitted; lsattr shows i
